description: Keep the lago-packages bases pinned and up to date. Extend it from any repository that builds on ghcr.io/getlago/*-base or *-build images. Dockerfiles reference them as `ARG RUNTIME_IMAGE=ghcr.io/getlago/<base>:<YYYYMMDD>-r<run>@sha256:<digest>`: Renovate moves tag and digest together, in one PR per repository, when lago-packages publishes a new base.

packageRules.description: lago-packages bases: versioned by publish (<YYYYMMDD>-r<run>: date = major, run = minor), pinned by digest, one grouped PR, any time, no release-age wait (base updates carry CVE fixes). The regex skips latest, commit-sha and per-arch (-aarch64) tags.
